Bitwarden / Vaultwarden

Industry-standard open-source password manager and credential vault

Open-source alternative to: 1Password
Visit Official Website ↗ GitHub Repository ★ 42,500

About Bitwarden / Vaultwarden

Bitwarden offers zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption for passwords, secure notes, TOTP tokens, and cards. Vaultwarden provides a lightweight Rust server backend.

Core Functionalities:

✓ Zero-knowledge AES-256 and PBKDF2 / Argon2 encryption
✓ Cross-platform browser extensions, iOS, Android, and CLI
✓ Secure sharing with organizations and family members
✓ Lightweight single-container deployment with Vaultwarden

Quick Self-Host Command:

# Deploy Bitwarden / Vaultwarden with Docker
docker run -d --name bitwarden -p 8080:80 bitwarden/latest
